## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users. Credit any upstream patches.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results, including output-file validation for PDF processing. Report skipped checks and intermittent failures.

## Review notes

- Privacy: document data, passwords and signatures remain on the device.
- Compatibility: describe effects on storage, routes, deployment and translations.
- Licensing: original licenses/notices are preserved; deployed source access remains available.
- UI changes: include screenshots for desktop/mobile and relevant RTL behavior when available.
